PrairieDusk_Text_Npc0.en: TAUROS stampedes at sunset. Stay\nbehind a tree.
PrairieDusk_Text_Npc0.fr: TAUROS charge au coucher du soleil.\nReste derrière un arbre.

PrairieDusk_Text_Npc1.en: I race PONYTA. I lose. Every time.
PrairieDusk_Text_Npc1.fr: Je fais la course contre PONYTA. Je\nperds. À chaque fois.

PrairieDusk_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

PrairieDusk_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
